# LevelPlay SDK Changelog

> Track updates to the ironSource Android SDK through a detailed changelog, highlighting new features, improvements, bug fixes, and compatibility changes for each version.

> **Important:**
>
> You are required to migrate your project to Maven Central before June 30,
> 2025\. The LevelPlay SDK and Ad Quality SDK for Android will no longer be
> accessible on IS.com, so migrate now to avoid disruptions to your development
> workflow and to continue building your projects with Unity LevelPlay. For more
> information, refer to the [LevelPlay Android Maven Central Migration
> Guide](/grow/levelplay/sdk/unity/maven-central-migration-guide.md).

| SDK Version | Release Date | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 9.6.0       | 2026/08/13   | * Improved the SDK initialization functionality for greater resilience under poor network conditions.
* Reduced SDK initialization time.
* Updated the SDK to Kotlin 2.1.21 to align with current toolchain requirements.
* Fixed an issue that prevented loading Yandex’s banner ad format.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 9.5.0       | 2026/07/01   | - Introduced important updates to the Impression-Level Revenue (ILR) API to strengthen data governance and standardize access to sensitive revenue data:
  * Deprecated: `ImpressionDataReadyEvent(LevelPlayImpressionData impressionData)`
  * Replaced with: `OnInterstitialImpressionDataReady(LevelPlayImpressionData impressionData)`

- Updated the GDPR consent API to accept a boolean value applied across all networks. Passing a per-network map is now deprecated.

- Fixed crash issue related to `ConcurrentModificationException` in `AdUnitEventsWrapper.sendEvent` and `NullPointerException` during WebController initialization `(iAdsInitThreadOptimization)`.                                                                                                                                                  |
| 9.4.4       | 2026/06/17   | * Improved iSX (ironSource Exchange) SDK reliability to prevent edge-case failures and ensure correct behavior across supported mediation and privacy workflows.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| 9.4.3       | 2026/05/25   | - Fixed a Google Play upload blocker issue caused by `PackageManager.getInstalledApplications(0)`.

- Fixed a fullscreen ad issue where some ad networks trigger `onAdClosed` before `onAdDisplayed`. In affected cases, the ad instance could remain stuck for the remainder of the app session, which caused the following issues:
  * `isAdReady()` returned `NotReady("ad is showing")`
  * `show()` returned `ERROR_CODE_SHOW_WHILE_SHOW`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| 9.4.2       | 2026/05/06   | * Fixed a threading issue that could lead to increased ANR (application not responding) rates during SDK initialization and ad loading caused by `IronSourceThreadManager.postOnUiThreadTask`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| 9.4.1       | 2026/04/28   | - Fixed a `java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` crash caused by a mismatch between the networks configured on the LevelPlay platform and the adapters integrated in the app.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| 9.4.0       | 2026/04/05   | * Introduced a new `LevelPlayPrivacySettings` class and dedicated APIs to simplify the management of privacy settings, including `setGDPRConsents`, `setCCPA`, `setCOPPA`. Refer to the [Regulation advanced settings for Android](/grow/levelplay/sdk/android/regulation-advanced-settings.md) for updated information on implementing GDPR, CCPA, and child-directed app privacy consent.

* Deprecated the use of `LevelPlay.setMetaData` for `do_not_sell`, `is_child_directed`, and `LevelPlay.setConsent` in favor of the new privacy APIs.

* Added support for Meta testing within the [Integration Testing Suite](/grow/levelplay/sdk/android/integration-test-suite.md).

* Fixed a crash in the Banner view caused by an `IllegalStateException` in Android.

* Fixed JavaDoc not working for LevelPlay APIs in Android. |
| 9.3.0       | 2026/01/20   | - Publishers can now use a new API to easily get rewarded ad details (value/type) before the ad loads or shows. This improves the user experience by enabling accurate pre-display of reward info (for example, on "Get Reward" buttons). The API prioritizes placement-level rewards, falling back to ad unit-level rewards. This replaces the removed `IronSource.getRewardedVideoPlacementInfo` API.
- Enhanced fallback logic to optimize fill rate.
- Updated targetSdkVersion and compileSdkVersion in the SDK to 36.
- Implemented various bug fixes, improved overall SDK performance, and reduced the SDK's footprint.                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 9.2.0       | 2025/11/26   | * Show Recovery – New fallback logic to optimize fill rate. This improvement provides a backup ad in the rare case where the first ad attempted to be shown fails.
* Fixed ANR when networks were running on UI thread.
* Fixed crash on IronSourceThreadManager.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| 9.1.0       | 2025/11/05   | - Support creative ID enrichment from ad networks adapters
- Fixed ANR issue with setMetaData on main thread
- iAds: Google Play Inline Store                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| 9.0.0       | 2025/09/17   | * All public-facing APIs have been refactored from IronSource to LevelPlay for enhanced clarity and consistency
* All deprecated APIs were removed.
* Add onAdShowFailed callback for custom network integration.
* Remove onAdShowSuccess for custom network integration. The onAdVisible should be used instead.
* This version is compatible only with AdQuality SDK 9+ and mediation adapters 5+.
* The LevelPlay mediated adapters are now available in Maven only. Learn more here.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
